segs.text: Imagine a notebook shared by everyone in your apartment building.
parts: Imagine a notebook shared by everyone in your apartment building.

segs.text: Today, most records live with one keeper: a bank, a registry, a company. If that one book is wrong, lost or quietly changed, you just have to trust them.
parts: Today, most records live with one keeper: a bank, a registry, a company.
If that one book is wrong, lost or quietly changed, you just have to trust them.

segs.text: A blockchain is a shared notebook that thousands of computers keep at the same time.
parts: A blockchain is a shared notebook that thousands of computers keep at the same time.

segs.text: New entries are grouped into pages called blocks. Each page carries a fingerprint of the page before it, like links in a chain.
parts: New entries are grouped into pages called blocks.
Each page carries a fingerprint of the page before it, like links in a chain.

segs.text: Change one old entry, and its fingerprint changes. Every page after it breaks, and every other copy disagrees.
parts: Change one old entry, and its fingerprint changes.
Every page after it breaks, and every other copy disagrees.

segs.text: So before a new page is added, the computers must agree it's valid. No single keeper decides.
parts: So before a new page is added, the computers must agree it's valid.

segs.text: Bitcoin's chain has added a new block about every ten minutes since January, two thousand nine, with no central keeper.
parts: Bitcoin's chain has added a new block about every ten minutes since January, two thousand nine,

segs.text: The catch: a blockchain only proves what was written. If someone writes a lie, it becomes a permanent, well-recorded lie.
parts: The catch: a blockchain only proves what was written.
If someone writes a lie, it becomes a permanent, well-recorded lie.

segs.text: A blockchain doesn't make people honest. It makes records very hard to quietly change.
parts: A blockchain doesn't make people honest.
It makes records very hard to quietly change.

segs.text: Just like that notebook, when everyone holds a copy.
parts: Just like that notebook, when everyone holds a copy.
